* Own database platform architecture and administration across managed and self-hosted environments, including provisioning, configuration, inventory, ownership, and support lifecycle.
* Establish database availability, replication, failover, backup, retention, point-in-time recovery, and disaster recovery standards aligned with business recovery objectives.

* Lead database monitoring, performance diagnosis, capacity forecasting, storage management, maintenance, and job scheduling; partner with Engineering on query, index, and application access improvements.
* Own operational controls for database patching, version upgrades, schema deployments, data changes, and migrations, including approval, testing, compatibility, rollback limits, and validation.
* Manage privileged access, encryption, secrets, audit logging, retention, and secure handling of production data in partnership with Security and accountable data owners.
* Define safe processes for nonproduction data refreshes, masking, reconciliation, and data integrity checks. Ensure database incidents and changes integrate with Production Operations.

**Automation Security and Resilience**

* Establish infrastructure-as-code and reviewed delivery pipelines using Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, or equivalent tools. Standardize reusable patterns, testing, state protection, drift detection, and controlled rollout.
* Automate provisioning, maintenance, monitoring, recovery tasks, and routine operational workflows; provide governed self-service capabilities for Engineering.
* Implement cloud and database security controls with Security leadership, including least privilege, network segmentation, vulnerability remediation, secrets management, audit evidence, and exception tracking.
* Own infrastructure and database disaster recovery planning and exercises. Validate end-to-end SaaS recovery with Engineering and Production Operations, including dependencies, data consistency, and failback.

* Own cloud, colocation, and database infrastructure budgets, forecasts, cost allocation, capacity plans, and optimization initiatives in partnership with Finance.
* Evaluate total cost, including licensing, support, connectivity, data transfer, recovery capacity, and migration costs. Track utilization and service unit costs without compromising agreed reliability or security.

**About Continental Hospitals**

Continental Hospitals is a leading multispecialty, tertiary and quaternary care hospital located in the Financial District, Gachibowli, Hyderabad. Established in 2013 by Dr. Guru N. The hospital provides comprehensive healthcare services across Cardiac Sciences, Neurosciences, Oncology, Gastroenterology and Liver Sciences, Orthopedics, Emergency & Trauma, Critical Care, Women & Child Care, Transplant Sciences and several other specialties.

Accredited by Joint Commission International (JCI) and NABH, Continental Hospitals is committed to quality, patient safety, clinical excellence, innovation, integrity and compassionate healthcare.

Job Description

**Position:**
Operation Theatre Operations Manager

**Department:**
Operations

**Organization:**
Continental Hospitals

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Experience:**
12–18 Years (relevant experience)

**Industry Preference:**
Multispecialty Hospitals

Role Overview

Continental Hospitals is seeking an experienced and dynamic Operation Theatre Operations Manager to oversee the end-to-end functioning of the Operation Theatre complex. The candidate must have prior experience working in a multispecialty hospital and managing the operational functioning of
**9–10 Operation Theatres**
.

The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring efficient OT utilization, operational readiness, coordination with surgical teams, anesthesia, nursing, CSSD and other support departments, while maintaining patient safety, infection prevention standards and operational efficiency.

The role requires strong operational leadership, planning, resource management and the ability to manage a high-volume, complex surgical environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Operation Theatre Operations& Management

* Oversee day-to-day operations of the Operation Theatre complex comprising 9–10 OTs.
* Ensure efficient scheduling, allocation and utilization of OTs.
* Monitor OT start times, turnover time, delays, cancellations and utilization.
* Ensure operational readiness of OTs for scheduled and emergency surgeries.
* Coordinate elective, emergency and specialty-specific surgical schedules.
* Monitor surgical workflow and ensure smooth functioning throughout the OT complex.
* Ensure adequate availability of equipment, instruments, consumables and supplies.

2. Surgical Coordination & Stakeholder Management

* Coordinate with surgeons, anesthesiologists, OT nursing teams and surgical departments.
* Facilitate smooth coordination between OT, ICU, wards, admissions, CSSD, radiology, blood bank and pharmacy.
* Resolve operational bottlenecks affecting surgical workflow.
* Conduct regular operational meetings with stakeholders.
* Ensure effective communication regarding surgical schedules, emergencies and OT availability.

3. OT Utilization & Operational Efficiency

* Monitor OT utilization and productivity across all theatres.
* Develop systems to improve OT scheduling, turnaround time and surgical throughput.
* Analyze delays, cancellations, idle time and operational inefficiencies.
* Implement process improvements to enhance productivity and patient flow.
* Develop dashboards and operational reports to track OT performance.

4. Patient Safety & Quality

* Ensure adherence to hospital protocols, patient safety standards and surgical checklists.
* Monitor compliance with WHO Surgical Safety Checklist and other applicable safety protocols.
* Ensure implementation of infection prevention and control practices within the OT complex.
* Coordinate with Quality, Infection Control and clinical teams during audits.
* Ensure compliance with NABH, JCI and applicable statutory and institutional standards.

5. Equipment, Infrastructure & Inventory Management

* Ensure availability, functionality and maintenance of OT equipment.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance, calibration and servicing of critical equipment.
* Monitor OT inventory, consumables, implants and surgical supplies.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Biomedical Engineering and CSSD for timely availability of resources.
* Ensure appropriate utilization and accountability of equipment and supplies.

6. Workforce & Team Management

* Manage and coordinate OT personnel, including OT nursing, technicians and operational support teams.
* Ensure adequate staffing and manpower allocation based on surgical workload.
* Monitor attendance, shift allocation, productivity and performance.
* Develop training, competency assessment and performance improvement initiatives.
* Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability and patient safety.

7. CSSD & Sterility Coordination

* Ensure effective coordination with CSSD for timely availability of sterile instruments and sets.
* Monitor instrument availability, turnaround and traceability.
* Address operational issues impacting surgical readiness.
* Ensure adherence to sterilisation, storage and handling protocols in coordination with CSSD.

8. Financial & Operational Governance

* Monitor operational expenditure and resource utilisation.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising patient safety.
* Monitor utilisation of high-value equipment and surgical resources.
* Support budgeting, forecasting and operational planning for the OT complex.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* OT utilisation rate.
* First-case on-time start percentage.
* OT turnaround time.
* Surgery cancellation rate.
* OT delay percentage and reasons.
* Emergency OT response and readiness.
* Surgical throughput and productivity.
* Equipment uptime and preventive maintenance compliance.
* Inventory control and consumable utilisation.
* Patient safety and audit compliance.
* Team productivity and manpower utilisation.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Healthcare Management, Hospital Administration or a relevant discipline.
* Master's degree in Hospital Administration / Healthcare Management preferred.
* **12–18 years of relevant experience in hospital operations.**
* **Mandatory experience in a multispecialty hospital.**
* **Must have independently managed the operations of approximately 9–10 Operation Theatres.**
* Experience in managing high-volume surgical operations and complex OT workflows.
* Strong understanding of NABH/JCI standards, patient safety and infection control practices.
